name: ru.tachka/shop
title: Tachka.ru Auto Parts Store (Тачка.Ру)
description: Search auto parts, oils, and accessories on Tachka.ru, quote RU/CIS delivery, and place orders.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. Omit cart_token to start a new cart — the response's cart_token must be carried into every later cart, delivery, and checkout call. The price is re-validated live at this moment and again at checkout; if it changed, checkout reports prices_changed instead of placing the order.

product_id.description: Product ID from search_products or get_product_details.

city_id.description: Destination city ID for local currency pricing. Default: 414 (Moscow).

cart_token.description: From a previous add_to_cart response. Omit to start a new cart.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Place the order for the cart identified by cart_token. Call ONLY after the customer has explicitly confirmed the purchase and given their name plus phone or email. There is no online payment step: the order is registered as a lead and the store confirms it with the customer by phone/email (delivery point and payment link are arranged in that confirmation). Moscow-area orders deliver by the store's courier to address (or "pickup" at the Moscow warehouse); other cities ship to a carrier pickup point — if the point is unknown, submit anyway and the operator will confirm it. Answer "prices_changed" means the cart was repriced to live prices: call get_cart, tell the customer the new prices, and submit again only if they accept.

cart_token.description: The cart_token returned by add_to_cart. The order is built from this cart; a retried call on the same cart returns the same order (durable idempotency).

city_id.description: Destination city ID (use search_cities to look up; default 414 = Moscow). Should match the city used for cart prices.

last_name.description: Customer last name (collected for carrier delivery; Moscow courier orders are first-name-only by policy).

phone.description: Customer phone in any RU/CIS format (normalized server-side). Phone or email is required.

email.description: Customer email. Phone or email is required.

comment.description: Free-form order comment for the operator.

address.description: Street address for courier delivery in the local-courier zone (Moscow area).

pickup_point_id.description: Carrier pickup point ID from search_pickup_points, when the customer chose one.

pickup_point_address.description: Pickup point address (required when pickup_point_id is set).

pickup_point_carrier_id.description: Carrier ID for the chosen pickup point.

delivery_method.description: courier (default in the local-courier zone) | pickup (our Moscow warehouse) | pickup_point (carrier pickup point).

vin.description: Vehicle VIN or body code, when known — required later for fitment-checked parts.

tools.name: estimate_delivery
tools.description: Estimate shipping prices and delivery timeframes for the current cart in a destination city_id (use search_cities first for non-Moscow cities). Optionally pass pickup_point_id + pickup_point_carrier_id from search_pickup_points to price a specific pickup point. Returns courier, pickup-point, and carrier options in the city's currency.

city_id.description: Destination city ID (use search_cities to look up). Default: 414 (Moscow).

pickup_point_id.description: Optional pickup_point_id from search_pickup_points to get an exact quote for that point.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Current cart contents with live prices, line totals and the grand total. Empty cart returns empty items and zero totals (not an error).

city_id.description: Destination city ID for local currency pricing. Default: 414 (Moscow).

tools.name: get_checkout_url
tools.description: Produce a one-time link (valid 5 minutes) that opens the live Tachka.ru checkout in a browser with this cart pre-loaded and the city pre-selected. Use it to hand the purchase to a human instead of placing the order yourself; checkout on the site re-validates live prices.

city_id.description: The delivery city; the opened checkout pre-selects it. Default: 414 (Moscow).

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Full details for one product_id returned by search_products: brand, SKU, price, stock, exact delivery and pickup dates for city_id, attributes, description (plain text) and image URLs.

product_id.description: Product ID from a search_products result.

city_id.description: Destination city ID for local currency and delivery dates. Default: 414 (Moscow).

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Look up a delivery city_id by name across Russia and the CIS (Kazakhstan, Belarus, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan). Call this first whenever the customer is outside Moscow (default city_id is 414 = Moscow). Pass the returned city_id into search_products, get_product_details, cart tools, estimate_delivery, search_pickup_points and checkout for local currency and exact delivery dates.

query.description: City name query (at least 2 characters, Russian preferred, e.g. 'Казань', 'Санкт-Петербург', 'Алматы').

tools.name: search_pickup_points
tools.description: List and filter carrier pickup points (CDEK, Yandex, KIT, Energia, etc.) available in a destination city_id (use search_cities first). Pass the chosen pickup_point_id, pickup_point_carrier_id and address into estimate_delivery or checkout.

city_id.description: Destination city ID from search_cities (e.g. 414 = Moscow).

carrier.description: Optional carrier name filter (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'СДЭК', 'Яндекс', 'КИТ').

limit.description: Maximum pickup points to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Tachka.ru auto-parts catalog. Accepts a part name, an OEM/article number, a 17-character VIN, or a car + part combination (e.g. "тормозные колодки киа рио 3", "P24061", "коврики BMW X5 G05"). The catalog is in Russian; Russian queries give the best results. Supports optional in_stock_only, brand, originality ("original" or "analog"), and limit filters. Returns matching categories, facets (brands, price range, stock/originality counts) and products with live prices, stock and delivery dates. city_id switches prices and links to that country's currency/domain; delivery/pickup date ESTIMATES in search results are indicative for Moscow — exact dates for the customer's city come from get_product_details and estimate_delivery.

query.description: Search query: part name, OEM/article number, VIN, or car + part. The catalog is Russian; Russian queries give the best results.

city_id.description: Destination city ID (use search_cities to look up). Default: 414 (Moscow).

in_stock_only.description: When true, return only products currently in stock.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set a product's quantity in the cart. quantity 0 removes the item. Returns the full cart snapshot, same as add_to_cart.

quantity.description: New quantity (0 removes the item, max 100).

city_id.description: Destination city ID for local currency pricing. Default: 414 (Moscow).
